description: The beta checklist (ADR 0064, docs/BETA_ONBOARDING_SPEC.md §7). The backend serves it to beta testers only (GET /v1/beta), filtered to the items whose features ship on the asking platform. The site's /beta page and the welcome mail read the same items. English only: the beta is English.

copy.title: Beta
copy.deal: Your part: use Septena for real, try what is below, and tell me what you find. My part: a year of Pro when Septena launches.
copy.intro: Tick what you tried. When something breaks or confuses you, send a note from that item.
copy.ack: I used Septena for real this week
copy.ackDone: Thanks. You last said so on {date}.
copy.cardBody: Thanks for testing Septena. Your checklist is in Settings, under Beta.

items.title: Sort your Inbox into Today
items.try: Capture a few tasks, then move them from the Inbox at the top of Today into Today, an area or a project.

items.title: Do one task
items.try: Pick one task to Do and work from it. Check that it stays with you on every screen.

items.title: Use a second device
items.try: Sign in on another device. Change a task on one and check that the change arrives on the other.

items.title: Let a few tasks fade
items.try: Leave some tasks alone for a while. They fade, and once a week Septena asks if you still want them.

items.title: Connect your agent
items.try: Connect Claude or another agent and give it one task you can check.

items.title: Review and stop an agent
items.try: Answer its question, then Accept or Send back its work in Review. Press Stop on a task, or Pause all agents.

items.title: Discuss a task
items.try: Open a task and press Discuss. Talk it through and see what it suggests.

items.title: Move in from another app
items.try: Bring your tasks over from the app you use now. Tell me what came across wrong.

items.title: Add a task with Siri or Shortcuts
items.try: Add a task with Siri or a Shortcut, or bring your Reminders into the Inbox.

items.title: Capture from anywhere
items.try: Add a task from wherever you are: Quick Entry, Quick Add or the share sheet.
